concerns.text: The central research question—quantifying performance loss when crystal‑structure information is excluded—requires a structure‑aware baseline. The plan defers FR‑005 and FR‑006 (structure‑aware graph construction and performance gap calculation) because no open CIF dataset is available, yet later sections (e.g., FR‑006 in the spec) still assert that ΔR² will be reported. This makes the primary claim untestable with the proposed methodology.

The plan notes a limited sample size (≤ 10 000 records) and states that 5‑fold CV variance will be reported as an indicator of stability, but it provides no formal power analysis to show that this sample is sufficient to detect the expected ΔR² between composition‑only and structure‑aware models. Without such analysis, the study may be under‑powered to support its conclusions.
